verdict.rationale: Google's own Calendar API docs say the RESTful API can be used through official Google Client Libraries, so first-party SDKs exist. The pack has only this one mention, with no detail on languages, installation, quickstarts or SDK feature coverage, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: list of supported SDK languages, SDK-specific docs or quickstarts, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Google Calendar API is a RESTful API that can be accessed through explicit HTTP calls or using the Google Client Libraries.
